title: Add Comparison Slider
content: Create image comparison slider. Container: relative overflow-hidden aspect-video. Before image: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover. After image: absolute inset-0, clip-path to show portion. Slider: absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-1 bg-white shadow-lg cursor-ew-resize, with handle (circle with arrows icon). Drag: update clip-path position on mouse/touch move.

variants.detailed: Create image comparison slider. Container: relative overflow-hidden aspect-video. Before image: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover. After image: absolute inset-0, clip-path to show portion. Slider: absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-1 bg-white shadow-lg cursor-ew-resize, with handle (circle with arrows icon). Drag: update clip-path position on mouse/touch move.
variants.advanced: Create robust image comparison component. Images: before and after, both same aspect ratio, lazy loading, alt text. Clip modes: horizontal (left/right), vertical (top/bottom). Slider line: customizable color and width, subtle shadow for visibility. Handle: circular with grip lines or arrows, larger touch target on mobile. Drag behavior: track mouse/touch position, clamp to container bounds, smooth performance with requestAnimationFrame. Initial position: prop for starting position (default 50%). Keyboard: Tab to focus handle, arrow keys to move, Home/End for limits. Labels: optional "Before" and "After" labels on respective sides. Overlay info: optional text overlays on each image. Reset button: return to initial position. Hover effect: optional slight handle highlight on hover. Touch support: drag on touch devices, prevent scroll while dragging. Responsive: handle size adapts to container size. Loading: skeleton placeholder while images load. Accessibility: role="slider", aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, aria-label. Animation: optional intro animation sliding from one side. Multiple: support gallery of comparisons.
